scripts.prebuild: npx expo prebuild --clean && echo 'export NODE_BINARY='$(which node) > ./ios/.xcode.env.local
scripts.kill-gradle: (test -d android && (cd android && ./gradlew --stop)) ; pkill -9 -f GradleDaemon ; echo 'Gradle daemons stopped'
scripts.build-eas:ios: npm run test && eas build -p ios
scripts.build-eas-then-submit:ios: npm run test && eas build -p ios && eas submit -p ios --latest
scripts.build-eas:android-aab: npm run test && eas build -p android
scripts.build-local:ios-ipa: npm run test && eas build -p ios --local
scripts.build-local-then-submit:ios-ipa: npm run test && eas build -p ios --local && eas submit -p ios
scripts.eas-update: npm run test && rm -rf dist && expo export --source-maps && eas update --channel production --skip-bundler --input-dir dist --message "OTA update" && sentry-expo-upload-sourcemaps dist
scripts.build-and-upload:ios: npm run test && eas build -p ios --local --output ./build.ipa && npm run upload:ios
scripts.build-and-upload:android: npm run test && eas build -p android --local --output ./build.aab && npm run upload:android
scripts.repack-and-upload:ios: npm run test && node scripts/repack.js ios && npm run upload:ios
scripts.repack-and-upload:android: npm run test && node scripts/repack.js android && npm run upload:android
scripts.repack-and-upload: npm run repack-and-upload:ios && npm run repack-and-upload:android
scripts.aab-to-apk: bundletool build-apks --bundle=$AAB_FILE --output=./temp.apks --mode=universal && unzip -o ./temp.apks -d ./apk-output && mv ./apk-output/universal.apk ./$(basename $AAB_FILE .aab).apk && rm -rf ./apk-output ./temp.apks && echo 'APK generated successfully'
scripts.build-local:ios-ipa:debug: echo "This script retains XCode logs for debugging build failures. Look for a message like 'Skipping cleanup, {path/to/logs} won't be removed.'" && /bin/sh -c 'export $(grep -v ^'#' .env.production | xargs) && EAS_LOCAL_BUILD_SKIP_CLEANUP=1 eas build -p ios --local
scripts.build-local:android-aab: npm run test && eas build -p android --local
